connector.name: Unlocalhost
connector.registryDescription: Deploy localhost to a private, authenticated link from your AI coding agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package unlocalhost. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the info-arnav account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UNLOCALHOST_URL
env.description: Base URL of the unlocalhost instance to talk to. Defaults to the hosted instance. Set this to point the tools at your own self hosted deployment.

env.name: UNLOCALHOST_TOKEN
env.description: API token. Normally written by the unlocalhost_login tool after you approve the device in a browser, so you should not need to set this by hand.
